decided: 2026-10-01, user-approved principle (2026-09-28): budgets proposed at construction, measured once by P11, adjusted once, then frozen
executor: claude-sonnet-4-6 / effort low via faithful wrapper; harness: frozen H0 v3
frozen_tool_calls_and_wall: unchanged per task (tool 60 for WRITE/IDEA, 120 for EXP/LIT; wall from each package's per-task container)

measurement.source: 19 scored P11 runs (p11-v5-sonnet46*), model calls used / budget
measurement.EXP: 9, 15 of 16 (15: frozen-H0 4-observation window caused 3 crashes; reserve stop)
measurement.LIT: 14, 15, 21, 22, 29 of 30 (29: frozen-H0 loop rewriting one file 18 times)

adjustment: none. The two near-cap runs are explained by known frozen-H0 defects (wasted calls), not by insufficient budget; every other run finished voluntarily with >= 8% headroom, most with ~50%. Lowering WRITE_CONTENT/IDEA would cut headroom that improved harnesses may legitimately use (e.g. re-reading their own outputs) without saving executor cost, since runs stop when done. Budgets are therefore frozen at the measured values.
scope: applies to these P11 development tasks and is the default for newly constructed units of the same task type; a new task with a clearly different workload is measured once by its own P11 run before freezing
